$comment: Stage 0 vocabulary: one flat file per corpus, at most 15 concepts, each defined.
Field names are a stable contract (the statements layer reads them).
Every field and when a stage allows it: references/vocabulary/model.md.

schemes.definition: Replace with one sentence naming the corpus this vocabulary covers.

concepts.definition: Replace with what this term means in this corpus, without repeating the label.
evidence: Replace with where the term is used or disputed, for example docs/setup.md:12.
